info.name: Atlassian Admin Account Issue Resolutions API

items.docs:
Changes the order of issue resolutions.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

params.name: startAt
params.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

params.name: id
params.description: The list of resolutions IDs to be filtered out

params.name: onlyDefault
params.description: When set to true, return default only, when IDs provided, if none of them is default, return empty page. Default value is false

items.docs:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of resolutions. The list can contain all resolutions or a subset determined by any combination of these criteria:

* a list of resolutions IDs.
* whether the field configuration is a default. This returns resolutions from company-managed (classic) projects only, as there is no concept of default resolutions in team-managed projects.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Permission to access Jira.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the issue resolution value.

Deletes an issue resolution.

This operation is [asynchronous](#async). Follow the `location` link in the response to determine the status of the task and use [Get task](#api-rest-api-3-task-taskId-get) to obtain subsequent updates.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).
